description.p: Equibop is a custom Discord desktop client aiming to give you better performance and a range of useful features.

screenshot.caption: Equicord settings page and about window open
A screenshot of a Discord server

ul.li: Upgraded to Electron 45

arRPC has been replaced with a new built-in Rich Presence implementation. Game detection is faster and more accurate, the Registered Games tab is back, and Discord now tracks your game activity. The separate "Configure Rich Presence" window and tray entry are gone
Advanced RPC requests (AUTHORIZE, OAuth2, etc.) are now supported
Modernised screenshare, and the audio share now stops properly when you end the stream
Screenshare picker: aborting now actually cancels, and "Source" text no longer wraps
Popout windows have a titlebar again
The window no longer un-maximises when restored from minimised
KDE: the tray icon now works when Equibop is autostarted
Linux: the unread badge now uses Electron's built-in badge count
Fixed relaunching the AppImage
Updater: no longer runs Setup on portable installs
Fixed splash screen theming
Windows builds are unsigned again for now
Upgraded to Electron 44, which fixes the eMudhra CA certificate issue
Spellcheck settings now show proper language names and have a search bar
The custom user agent now applies to the whole session, not just the main window
Windows builds are now code-signed
**Discord Titlebar** is now **Native Titlebar**. Same option inverted, your setting carries over, but Windows now defaults to Discord's titlebar
Window shadow and rounded corners are now toggleable
Zoom with the numpad
Windows: screenshare no longer captures other participants' voices
Fixed the updater and the audio source picker
Updated venmic to 7.2.1
Linux: `--enable-speech-dispatcher` was removed upstream, re-add it under Launch Arguments if you use TTS

description.p: This is a complete rewrite from the ground up. The v2 codebase had significant architectural issues that made it unmaintainable, so we've rebuilt Equibop with a cleaner foundation.

ul.li: Migrated from pnpm to bun for better performance and DX
Complete code restructure for improved maintainability
Some features from v2 are not yet re-implemented
Report issues at https://github.com/Equicord/Equibop/issues
